notes.title: Bugfix Update 1.1.20250909
notes.content: [list][*][p]Fixed visual bug where turn order list would not update correctly after swapping.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed bug where certain weapons for zikaron and agata would silently and unexpectedly deal additional damage.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a bug where certain weapons for zikaron and agata would not proc ailments as often as expected.[/p][/*][*][p]Force of Nature no longer bypasses stun or sleep ailments.[/p][/*][*][p]Force of Nature CAN now be affected by "seconds".[/p][/*][*][p]Fix audio volume blip when quitting the game in certain ways.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed various issues affecting battle actor positioning involving "seconds".[/p][/*][*][p]Increased drop rates for certain rare items on certain rare encounters.[/p][/*][*][p]Improved various NPC dialogue, Story screen triggers for improved clarity around endgame sidequests[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a rare crash during a cutscene in ch.10 (and possibly in other rare scenarios).[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a rare crash when changing scenes while a "camera hint" is present on-screen.[/p][/*][*][p]Adjustments to enemy balancing in the final dungeon, Jerome's side quest, and on hard mode.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed logging errors when loading saves and on Windows/MacOS when accessing certain navigation functions in ch.11 (may fix some rare crashes).[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed typo for a specific location name on the ch.11 minimap.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed some other minor dialogue/typos.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed/improved some minor map issues.[/p][/*][/list]

notes.title: Bugfix Update 1.1.20250905
notes.content: [list][*][p]Fixed shop bug where selling items could cause the cursor to render incorrectly[/p][/*][*][p]Revised Trip Mine description for accuracy[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a chapter 11 softlock when navigating a certain way south of Stral[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an out of bounds in an endgame dungeon that allowed you to bypass the boss[/p][/*][*][p]Minor performance improvements when using the airship, certain UI operations, ending combat[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a location appearing on the minimap before it had been discovered[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a minor tiling issue in Cordelia's Chapter, Chapter 8[/p][/*][/list]

notes.title: Bugfix Update 1.0.20250901
notes.content: [list][*][p]Fixes two more softlocks when traversing the world map in certain ways in the final chapter.[/p][list][*][p]Added a world map "recovery mode" accessible from the debug menu to help people get out of any similar softlocks in case we've missed any (please continue to report these!); tap on the version number on the config menu from the title screen to access the debug menu[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]Fixed a typo in the Config menu helptext for one of the options[/p][/*][*][p]Made the movement puzzle in Ben's chapter more forgiving, significantly more so when the "Casual" difficulty mode is enabled.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a missing out of bounds collision in the final dungeon[/p][/*][/list]

notes.title: Quartet August Update Jamboree
notes.content:
Hi all,

Just wanted to send all of you a quick update. We have no specific topic we wanted to talk about, or area I'd like to show, so we think it'd be a good opportunity to do a bit of grab bag of screenshots. (The new stuff we are working on is heavy spoiler-filled and we want to save that for you when you play the game!) Speaking of which, we have just started work on Chapter 10 of 11. That means after this chapter is completed all we have left is the final dungeon and all the side and backer content. We are getting very, very close to releasing the game!

So without further ado, let's look at a collection of shots ranging from the very beginning of the game up through and including Chapter 9. I'll present them without any commentary, so you can let your imagination fill in the blanks!

Ok! That's it. Let me know in the comments if you enjoyed this style of update. As always, we sincerely appreciate all your support. Making JRPGs is the dream of this team and because of your support, we are making the best one we possibly can. We cannot wait for you to try it!

If you want to stay in touch, please join us on our [url=http://www.discord.gg/somethingclassic]discord [/url]and follow us on [url=https://twitter.com/SomethingClassc]twitter[/url]. Have a great day!

Team Something Classic

notes.title: QUARTET ARRIVES TO KICKSTARTER
notes.content:
[h1]QUARTET ARRIVES TO KICKSTARTER[/h1]
[h2]Classic turn-based indie RPG with tag-team mechanics[/h2]

[b]September 1st, 2021:[/b] Quartet, the second retro-inspired JRPG from games studio Something Classic, is live on Kickstarter now until September 30th, 2021.  A spiritual successor to Something Classic’s 2017 release, Shadows of Adam, Quartet lets players control eight characters across four stories that gradually merge into one epic quest.  Backers on Kickstarter can opt into a variety of rewards, from copies of the game to higher-level rewards like the chance to design epic gear, craft an NPC, or even write a whole quest!  Join the campaign: [url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/somethingclassic/quartet-0]https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/somethingclassic/quartet-0[/url]

[i]“Shadows of Adam was a success for us,”[/i] says producer Tyler Mire.  [i]“But we learned so much from the experience and the user feedback. We’ve put everything we’ve learned into Quartet to make it so much bigger and better than our last game.”[/i]

From the steampunk-inspired streets of Leornia, to the airship battles that rage on the battlefront of the Auslen Empire, Quartet takes players on an adventure they will never forget!  Meet a remarkable cast of characters including a snooty mage, a disillusioned soldier, an irreverent cook, a troubled shop girl, a sentient water mammal, a dashing doctor, a magical cop, and an ancient golem.  Collect oodles of powerful gear for your small army of protagonists, while unraveling an ancient conspiracy that literally reshaped the world centuries ago.

[b]Features include:[/b]
[list]
[*] Eight heroes with a unique roster of spells and abilities
[*] Tactically deep tag-team combat
[*] A sprawling, character-driven story
[*] Tons of epic and imaginative loot
[/list]


[b]ABOUT QUARTET[/b]
Quartet begins with four separate chapters, playable in any order.  In those four chapters, players meet eight unlikely heroes, and get to see how the stories intertwine into an epic narrative surrounding the war over the control of magic.  In battle, players deploy four characters at any time, with the ability to instantly swap the other four characters in, tag-team style.

[b]ABOUT SOMETHING CLASSIC[/b]
Something Classic is an indie studio with a passion for modern takes on the classic JRPG genre.  Their previous game, Shadows of Adam, was a cult hit among retro JRPG enthusiasts and is available on Steam, Nintendo Switch and Sony Playstation 4.

Quartet is on Kickstarter from September 1st 2021 through September 30th 2021 at [url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/somethingclassic/quartet-0]https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/somethingclassic/quartet-0[/url]
